title: ECHO-G: Embodied Co-speech Humanoid mOtion Generation
abstract: arXiv:2609.39575v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Generating full-body co-speech motion for humanoid robots requires coordinating speech prosody, linguistic content, and embodiment-specific motion. To this end, we present ECHO-G, a framework jointly conditioned on speech audio and timed transcripts. Its Speech-Grounded Diffusion Transformer (SGDiT) combines frame-aligned acoustic features with token-level linguistic context, preserving their distinct granularities. Trained with rectified flow matching, it models one-to-many utterance-motion relationships directly in robot space. To support training and evaluation, we introduce a BEAT2-derived audio-text-robot dataset and a benchmark covering co-speech characteristics, robot-motion quality, and runtime efficiency. Comparative evaluation supports direct robot-space generation over the evaluated human-motion generation and retargeting pipelines, while modality ablations highlight the benefits of joint audio-text conditioning. translated_title: ECHO-G：具身伴随语音人形机器人运动生成
translated_abstract: 为人形机器人生成伴随语音的全身运动，需要协调语音韵律、语言内容以及特定于机器人本体的运动。为此，我们提出了ECHO-G，这是一个同时以语音音频和带时间戳的转录文本为条件的框架。其语音引导扩散变换器（SGDiT）将帧对齐的声学特征与词元级别的语言上下文相结合，并保留了二者各自不同的粒度。该模型通过修正流匹配进行训练，直接在机器人空间中对“话语-运动”之间的一对多关系进行建模。为支持训练与评估，我们基于BEAT2构建了一个音频-文本-机器人数据集，并提出了一个涵盖伴随语音特性、机器人运动质量和运行效率的基准测试。对比评估表明，直接在机器人空间中生成运动优于所评估的人体运动生成与重定向流水线，而模态消融实验则凸显了音频与文本联合条件化的优势。此外，我们进一步……
tldr: 提出ECHO-G框架，通过语音引导扩散变换器（SGDiT）联合利用语音音频与时间对齐的文本信息，直接在机器人空间中为人形机器人生成与语音韵律和语言内容相协调的全身伴随语音运动。
en_tdlr: ECHO-G jointly conditions on speech audio and timed transcripts through a Speech-Grounded Diffusion Transformer to directly generate full-body co-speech motion for humanoid robots in robot space.
